The whole slice sits inside one contiguous statically-linked D3DX9 object block (continuing from slices 13-15, continuing into 16), and every function was assigned lib:d3dx. Checked run boundaries against the evidence transitions: matrix math (0x5bd384) -> shader-bytecode token walker (0x5bf18f) -> shader-version/CPUID table (0x5bf77c) -> tiny ctor/dtor/operator_new helpers (0x5bfea9) -> HLSL compiler codegen (0x5c18a0) -> shader assembler/lexer (0x5cd8e0) -> constant-register binding (0x5d1123) -> embedded libjpeg (0x5d1670) -> embedded zlib (0x5d2f00) -> embedded libpng (0x5d33d4) -> ID3DXConstantTable Set* family (0x5d4857) -> D3DX vector/matrix transform-array routines (0x5d62fb, continuing into slice 17). Each transition lines up with a genuine change in strings/callee pattern, consistent with MSVC per-object-file contiguity, and no gaps or overlaps were found between the reported boundaries.

Spot-checked several of the more ambiguous-looking functions with tools/pack.py:

- 0x5d62fb (claimed D3DX vector/matrix transform-array run): decompiled body is a quaternion-multiply (cross-term pattern matches D3DXQuaternionMultiply), consistent with D3DX math, not the engine's own math module.
